description: This file contains the internal implementation of the State struct used in the XxHash32 hashing algorithm within the Orleans code generator. It manages the hash state, processes data stripes, and computes the final hash value.

classes.name: XxHash32.State
classes.description: A private nested struct managing the internal state for the XXHash 32-bit hash algorithm, including processing input data and producing the final hash value.

methods.name: ProcessStripe
methods.description: Processes a full stripe (block) of input bytes to update the hash state.

methods.name: Converge
methods.description: Calculates a combined rotation of accumulator values to contribute to the final hash.

methods.name: ApplyRound
methods.description: Applies a mixing round to the accumulator with a portion of the input data.

methods.name: Complete
methods.description: Finalizes the hash computation, including processing remaining bytes.
